Agent Name: Planner

, Reason for Mistake: Misread Budd Boetticher’s birth year from the opened Wikipedia page, recording it as 1906 instead of 1916. This led to an incorrect interim conclusion (that Boetticher was born earlier than Don “Red” Barry) and misguided subsequent instructions based on the wrong date.
